question: 47e's original story, driven live for the first time: does narrowing a profile take effect on work that was already planned, queued and survived a process restart?
objective: Search my local knowledge using the query "neko" and show what you find.

steps.name: 1 the agent panel rendered
steps.detail: found by shape (a full-automation option), 4 action buttons, 2 objective textarea(s) — no UI prose was matched

steps.name: 2 the profile store is ON DISK, so there is something to narrow
steps.detail: persisted:study-tutor via media-assistant (4 profiles); active profile study-tutor carries 19 operations. The operation under test is chosen from the plan the model produces, not asserted here.

item.objective: Search my local knowledge using the query "neko" and show what you find.

steps.name: 4 the operation under test, chosen from the plan the model actually produced
steps.detail: dictionary.search-knowledge ("Search local knowledge", minimum read-only, no confirmation) — it is in the plan, in the profile's allow-list, and runnable at limited-actions, so the control arm can complete it and the only thing separating the arms is the narrowing

steps.name: 5 the process that planned the task has exited
steps.detail: the app exited cleanly, so the queue must now come back from disk rather than from component state

steps.name: 6 the persisted profile was forked into two identical copies
steps.detail: C:\Users\Arseniy\AppData\Local\Temp\jp-p7ref-20260802slice58-47192\narrowed and C:\Users\Arseniy\AppData\Local\Temp\jp-p7ref-20260802slice58-47192\control — both restart from the SAME plan, so the only variable below is whether the operation was removed

steps.name: 7 the queued task SURVIVED the process restart
steps.detail: narrowed arm: row present, status queued; control arm: row present, status queued. Without this, nothing below is about persistence.

steps.name: 8 the narrowing actually took, AND SURVIVED THE RESTART
steps.detail: narrowed arm: narrowed:19->18, dictionary.search-knowledge enabled = false before the restart and false after it; control arm untouched, enabled = true after its restart. The post-restart reading is the one that matters: the panel reads the profile store once, in a useState initializer, so a narrowing applied to a RUNNING panel is not the narrowing the run will see.

steps.name: 9 the queued row was RUN, not merely listed
steps.detail: narrowed arm click -> clicked:Run; control arm click -> clicked:Run. Before slice 51 there was no such button to click.

steps.name: 10 THE DIFFERENTIAL — same plan, same restart, one variable
steps.detail: narrowed: step dictionary.search-knowledge -> completed, error null; control: step dictionary.search-knowledge -> completed, error null. No usable difference between the arms — the narrowing never reached the code that runs the step, so this is NOT evidence that the allow-list is unenforced. AND THE CAUSE IS KNOWN: the narrowing IS on disk after the restart (targetEnabled=false) and the step ran anyway. `normalizeAgentProfiles()` discards every user edit to a BUILT-IN profile — it seeds its map with the factory defaults (localAgentProfiles.ts:146) and then skips any persisted profile whose id already collides (:151), which is all four built-ins. The panel is therefore handed the factory allow-list. Reproduce with `node docs/migration/tools/agent-profile-narrowing-probe.mjs` (CONFIRMED, with a custom-profile control).
